parameters.name: ApiPath
parameters.description:
The API path.

You can view the value of **API Path** on the API details page of **Data API**. For more information, see [View and use](~~206247~~).

sub_parameters.name: BetweenEnd
sub_parameters.description:
The end value when the service API request parameter represents a range.

You can view the value range of request parameters on the API details page of **Data API**. For more information, see [View and use](~~206247~~).
> If **Condition.N.Operate** is set to `BETWEEN` or `bt`, this parameter is required, and **Condition.N.Value** is not required.

sub_parameters.name: BetweenStart
sub_parameters.description:
The start value when the service API request parameter represents a range.

You can view the value range of request parameters on the API details page of **Data API**. For more information, see [View and use](~~206247~~).
> If **Condition.N.Operate** is set to `BETWEEN` or `bt`, this parameter is required, and **Condition.N.Value** is not required.

sub_parameters.name: FieldName
sub_parameters.description:
The request parameter name configured for the service API.

You can view the values of **Request Parameters** on the API details page of **Data API**. For more information, see [View and use](~~206247~~).

sub_parameters.name: Operate
sub_parameters.description:
The comparison operator.

Only `bt`, `eq`, `neq`, `rlike`, `in`, or `nin` are supported, along with their corresponding operators `BETWEEN`, `=`, `!=`, `LIKE`, `IN`, and `NIN`.

You can view the corresponding operators of request parameters on the API details page of **Data API**. For more information, see [View and use](~~206247~~).

- `BETWEEN`: The request parameter is assigned a specific range.
- `=`: The request parameter is assigned a specific value.
- `!=`: The request parameter is not assigned a specific value.
- `LIKE`: The request parameter value starts with a specific value.
- `IN`: The request parameter value belongs to a specific set.
- `NIN`: The request parameter value does not belong to a specific set.

For example, if a dataset has 6 records (with `time` values of `abcd`, `abce`, `abcf`, `abcg`, `aabc`, and `abbc`), and you call this operation with `Condition.N.FieldName="time"`:

- If `Condition.N.Operate="LIKE"` and `Condition.N.Value="abc"`, all records with `time=abcd`, `time=abce`, `time=abcf`, and `time=abcg` are returned.
- If `Condition.N.Operate="IN"` and `Condition.N.Value="[abcd,abce,abcf]"`, all records with `time=abcd`, `time=abce`, and `time=abcf` are returned.

> If this parameter is set to `BETWEEN`, **Condition.N.BetweenStart** and **Condition.N.BetweenEnd** are required. If this parameter is not set to `BETWEEN`, **Condition.N.Value** is required.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The comparison value, which is the value assigned to the service API request parameter.

You can view the values of request parameters on the API details page of **Data API**. For more information, see [View and use](~~206247~~).

> If **Condition.N.Operate** is not set to `BETWEEN` or `bt`, this parameter is required, and **Condition.N.BetweenStart** and **Condition.N.BetweenEnd** are not required.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance where the API resides.

For more information, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

parameters.name: IsoId
parameters.description: The logically isolated ID. Ignore this parameter.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

The number of records displayed on each page in the returned results. Maximum value: 100. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 100.
> This parameter is required when pagination is enabled.
